appliedCount.description: Lines that replaced a listing's availability.

staleCount.description: Lines skipped because their asOf was not after the listing's asOf.

appliedAt.description: When the feed reached APPLIED; omitted otherwise.

failureCode.description: The Err identifier of a FAILED feed, for example ErrListingNotOnNode; omitted otherwise.

409.description: feed-already-applied (ErrFeedAlreadyApplied), or concurrent-update (ErrConcurrentUpdate) after one automatic retry.

type.description: Problem type slug: the shared not-found, illegal-transition, concurrent-update and validation-failed, or one of this context's (invalid-item-dimensions, invalid-gtin, gtin-already-assigned, pack-quantity-immutable, pack-level-order, invalid-pack-quantity, invalid-pack-dimensions, invalid-pack-level, pack-level-not-found, negative-availability, stale-availability, node-not-sellable, duplicate-listing, listing-not-on-node, feed-already-applied).

422.description: The feed is FAILED, instance /inventory-feeds/{feedId}: listing-not-on-node (ErrListingNotOnNode) or negative-availability (ErrNegativeAvailability). Or validation-failed for a malformed or oversized request (nothing is recorded).

type.description: Problem type slug: the shared not-found, illegal-transition, concurrent-update and validation-failed, or one of this context's (invalid-item-dimensions, invalid-gtin, gtin-already-assigned, pack-quantity-immutable, pack-level-order, invalid-pack-quantity, invalid-pack-dimensions, invalid-pack-level, pack-level-not-found, negative-availability, stale-availability, node-not-sellable, duplicate-listing, listing-not-on-node, feed-already-applied).
